bool set_coordinator_check_adv_rsi(uint8_t report_data_len, uint8_t *p_report_data, uint8_t *bd_addr, uint8_t addr_type)

csis_client.h

  • p_report_data -- [in] Pointer to advertising report data.

  • false -- CSIS client check on advertising RSI failed.

bool set_coordinator_cfg_discover(T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE group_handle, bool discover, uint32_t timeout_ms)

Set coordinator configure discover mode.

csis_client.h

Parameters:

  • group_handle -- [in] LE Audio group handle: T_BLE_AUDIO_GROUP_HANDLE.

  • discover -- [in] The status for discover set member.

    • true set_coordinator is discovering set member.

    • false set_coordinator is not discovering set member.

  • timeout_ms -- [in] Discover timeout. Unit: ms.

Return values:

  • true -- Set coordinator configure discover mode is successful.

  • false -- Set coordinator configure discover mode failed.

Returns:

The result of set coordinator configure discover mode.

  • p_mem_info -- [in] Pointer to set member information: T_CSIS_SET_MEM_INFO.

Return values:

Returns:

The result of set coordinator add LE Audio group.
